title: Vulnerability digest — 25 Nov 2026, 23:05 CET
markdown:
- **CVE-2026-133323**, Mitel MiCollab, This vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary system commands via an OS command injection flaw in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component. Links: [https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-133323](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-133323), [https://www.mitel.com/support/security-advisories/mitel-product-security-advisory-misa-2026-0012](https://www.mitel.com/support/security-advisories/mitel-product-security-advisory-misa-2026-0012), [https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk)
- **CVE-2023-25915**, Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series, This improper input validation vulnerability could allow a remote attacker to run arbitrary commands on the affected system. Links: [https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2023-25915](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2023-25915), [https://www.danfoss.com/en/service-and-support/coordinated-vulnerability-disclosure/danfoss-security-advisories/dsa-2023-08-01](https://www.danfoss.com/en/service-and-support/coordinated-vulnerability-disclosure/danfoss-security-advisories/dsa-2023-08-01), [https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk)
- **CVE-2026-133469**, Vates Xen Orchestra, This vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication and perform administrative actions using a crafted authentication token containing an empty JSON object. Links: [https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-133469](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-133469), [https://docs.vates.tech/security-advisories/advisories/2026/vates-sa-2026-062/](https://docs.vates.tech/security-advisories/advisories/2026/vates-sa-2026-062/), [https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk)
- **CVE-2023-25914**, Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series, This path traversal vulnerability could allow an attacker to access and read underlying server system files via the XML interface. Links: [https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2023-25914](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2023-25914), [https://www.danfoss.com/en/service-and-support/coordinated-vulnerability-disclosure/danfoss-security-advisories/dsa-2023-08-01](https://www.danfoss.com/en/service-and-support/coordinated-vulnerability-disclosure/danfoss-security-advisories/dsa-2023-08-01), [https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk)
- **CVE-2026-133303**, Mitel MiCollab, This vulnerability permits an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands using pre-staged malicious content via an XML injection flaw in the AWV component. Links: [https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-133303](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-133303), [https://www.mitel.com/support/security-advisories/mitel-product-security-advisory-misa-2026-0012](https://www.mitel.com/support/security-advisories/mitel-product-security-advisory-misa-2026-0012), [https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk)
- **CVE-2025-41450**, Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series, This improper authentication vulnerability could allow an attacker to generate a web report exposing sensitive information such as internal IP addresses, usernames, and store names. Links: [https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-41450](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-41450), [https://www.danfoss.com/en/service-and-support/coordinated-vulnerability-disclosure/danfoss-security-advisories/dsa-2025-03-01](https://www.danfoss.com/en/service-and-support/coordinated-vulnerability-disclosure/danfoss-security-advisories/dsa-2025-03-01), [https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk)
- **CVE-2026-133324**, Mitel MiCollab, This vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication controls and perform unauthorized actions due to a failure to fail securely in the AWV component. Links: [https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-133324](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-133324), [https://www.mitel.com/support/security-advisories/mitel-product-security-advisory-misa-2026-0012](https://www.mitel.com/support/security-advisories/mitel-product-security-advisory-misa-2026-0012), [https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk)
- **CVE-2026-133311**, Mitel MiCollab, This weak authentication vulnerability in the AWV component could let an unauthenticated attacker access sensitive information using a specific system-generated random identifier or pre-staged content. Links: [https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-133311](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-133311), [https://www.mitel.com/support/security-advisories/mitel-product-security-advisory-misa-2026-0012](https://www.mitel.com/support/security-advisories/mitel-product-security-advisory-misa-2026-0012), [https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk)
- **CVE-2026-133275**, Mitel MiCollab, This vulnerability enables an unauthenticated attacker to upload arbitrary files due to insufficient file type validation in the AWV component. Links: [https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-133275](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-133275), [https://www.mitel.com/support/security-advisories/mitel-product-security-advisory-misa-2026-0012](https://www.mitel.com/support/security-advisories/mitel-product-security-advisory-misa-2026-0012), [https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk)
- **CVE-2026-135227**, MongoDB Ruby Driver, This association-handling flaw allows structured input to be treated as an already-stored record, which can let an unauthenticated party modify or remove stored records and render individual records unreadable. Links: [https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-135227](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-135227), [https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/MONGOID-5969](https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/MONGOID-5969)
- **CVE-2026-135898**, MongoDB Python Driver, An out-of-bounds read in the native C BSON decoding extension can allow an unauthenticated party to terminate the application process using crafted BSON data and potentially leak process memory in error messages. Links: [https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-135898](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-135898), [https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/PYTHON-6256](https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/PYTHON-6256)
- **CVE-2026-135141**, MongoDB Ruby Driver, A query-building logic flaw causes model-level default restrictions to be silently discarded, enabling a user with basic application privileges to read, change, or remove records that should have been withheld. Links: [https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-135141](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-135141), [https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/MONGOID-6025](https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/MONGOID-6025)
- **CVE-2026-135226**, MongoDB Ruby Driver, A type-confusion weakness in the Extended JSON parsing component allows input to be read as additional or replacement document fields, which can cause unintended data modifications when untrusted data is parsed and stored. Links: [https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-135226](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-135226), [https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/RUBY-3936](https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/RUBY-3936)
- **CVE-2026-135146**, MongoDB Python Driver, An improper certificate revocation check in optional TLS support allows a network endpoint holding a revoked certificate to trick a client into accepting the connection, risking credential disclosure and response spoofing. Links: [https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-135146](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-135146), [https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/PYTHON-6189](https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/PYTHON-6189)

items.title: An improper restriction of dynamically determined object attributes in the object-document mapping library's association…
items.match_text:
An improper restriction of dynamically determined object attributes in the object-document mapping library's association handling allows structured input supplied in place of a simple identifier value to be turned into an object that is treated as an already-stored record of a caller-chosen model class. In applications that pass unfiltered request data into the affected association handling, an unauthenticated party may cause unintended modification or removal of stored records, and may render an individual record unreadable through that association.
MongoDB Ruby Driver

items.title: An out-of-bounds read in the native C BSON decoding extension of the MongoDB Python Driver may allow an unauthenticated …
items.match_text:
An out-of-bounds read in the native C BSON decoding extension of the MongoDB Python Driver may allow an unauthenticated party who can supply crafted BSON data to the decoder to cause the application process to terminate. In some configurations, nearby process memory may be included in error messages, which may result in limited unintended disclosure of data.
MongoDB Python Driver

items.title: A logic flaw in the query-building layer of the Mongoid object-document mapper causes a model-level default restriction …
items.match_text:
A logic flaw in the query-building layer of the Mongoid object-document mapper causes a model-level default restriction that is meant to return no records to be silently discarded when it is combined into a query. A user with basic application privileges who sends an ordinary request may read, change, or remove records that the restriction was intended to withhold.
MongoDB Ruby Driver

items.title: A type-confusion weakness in the Extended JSON parsing component of BSON for Ruby allows a party who can supply parser i…
items.match_text:
A type-confusion weakness in the Extended JSON parsing component of BSON for Ruby allows a party who can supply parser input to influence how a serialized document is framed. Content placed in one value may be read back as additional or replacement document fields. An unauthenticated party supplying input to an application that parses untrusted Extended JSON and stores the result may cause unintended modification of stored data.
MongoDB Ruby Driver

items.title: An improper certificate revocation check in the MongoDB Python Driver's optional TLS revocation-checking support allows …
items.match_text:
An improper certificate revocation check in the MongoDB Python Driver's optional TLS revocation-checking support allows an unauthenticated party that operates the network endpoint a client connects to, and that holds a revoked but still-dated certificate trusted by that client, to have the connection accepted. This may result in unintended disclosure of application credentials and other session data, and in the client treating responses from that endpoint as genuine.
MongoDB Python Driver
